events.name: Bash
events.head: Check prices lock comment, git state and task statuses
events.input: $ git log --oneline -5 -- app/src/lib/prices.json; grep -n -i "lock" app/src/lib/prices.json; git status --short app/src/lib/prices.json workshop-plan/tasks | head; git log origin/main --oneline -1 2>/dev/null; git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD 2>/dev/null; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether the lock commit is pushed and read T-004 and T-103 details
events.input: $ git branch -r --contains d18817d; git remote -v; git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD | cat; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm lock comment is on origin and re-run live wiring probe
events.input: $ git fetch origin main -q 2>&1 | tail -2; git show origin/main:app/src/lib/prices.json | grep -c "locked 2026-10-09 (orchestrator)"; git diff origin/main HEAD --stat -- app/src/lib/prices.json | cat; cd app && node scripts/probe-live-wiring.mjs 2>&1 | tail -15

events.name: Bash
events.head: Close T-103 and T-004, ack the note, show resulting state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py set T-103 status=done note="Recheck after T-004: nothing had to change. The price table is locked (USD 99, INR 9,999, EUR 89, GBP 79, AUD 149, CAD 139, SGD 129, AED 369), the lock note is on origin main, and all three done_when items are met (probe-currency on the mirror 2026-10-08, page price equals Dodo price for DE, PL, IN and US on 2026-09-24, table confirmed in T-004). Closed." 2>&1 | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Commit the task board update
events.input: $ git status --short workshop-plan/tasks | cat; git add -- workshop-plan/tasks/tasks.json && git commit -q -m "Agent T-004: decision rechecked as already carried out, live wiring probe re-run and passing, T-103 closed out of recheck
